game_title: Input Interpreter – Lava Tube Tunnel Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the trust value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Input Interpreter' (Week 2 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 21.
